text: Brazil is the only country to have played in every single World Cup since 1930!
The first World Cup was held in Uruguay in 1930, and Uruguay won it at home!
Germany scored 7 goals against Brazil in a single match in 2014 - the most goals ever in a World Cup semi-final!
Lionel Messi finally won his first World Cup trophy in 2022 after playing in 5 World Cups!
The youngest player to score in a World Cup Final was Pele - he was only 17 years old!
The 2022 World Cup in Qatar was the first ever held in the Middle East!
A World Cup soccer ball travels about 3,000 kilometers during the whole tournament!
Brazil has won the most World Cups ever - 5 times! They won in 1958, 1962, 1970, 1994, and 2002.
Diego Maradona scored the famous 'Hand of God' goal against England in 1986!
The World Cup trophy is made of 18 karat gold and weighs about 6 kilograms - that's like a small dog!
Over 3 billion people watched the 2022 World Cup Final - that's almost half of everyone on Earth!
The 2022 World Cup Final between Argentina and France is considered one of the greatest finals ever, ending 3-3 before penalties!
Kylian Mbappe scored a hat-trick (3 goals) in the 2022 World Cup Final - the first since 1966!
The fastest goal in World Cup history was scored in just 11 seconds!
The mascot for the first World Cup was a boy named Gauchito in Argentina 1978!
